name: windowedTally
summary: Bucket K timestamp streams into per-day counts over a rolling N-day UTC window, aligned to one label axis. Two properties are the point: EMPTY DAYS ARE PRESENT (the window is built first and streams tally into it, where deriving labels from the data silently compresses quiet days out of the axis and makes a gap look like a dip), and THE SERIES ARE ALIGNED (every series has one entry per label, in order, so index i means the same day in all of them — a chart layering two series cannot check this). UTC because a window whose bucket boundaries move with the viewer's timezone makes the same data tell two stories. Harvested from the Fleet page's throughput panel (#3462/#3465).
